phone.none.title: No phone linked yet
phone.none.body: Link a phone with the NoCap OS app in Settings → Devices and its screen pulls up right here.
phone.pick.title: Pick a phone
phone.pick.body: Whose screen are we vibing with today?
phone.link.nearbyHint: Your phone’s on the same network as this server — fast lane
phone.link.remoteHint: Your phone’s reaching this server over the internet
phone.jpegHint: This browser can’t play the phone’s video, so you get still pics instead (a bit laggier).
phone.st.askingBody: Your phone’s asking if it’s cool to share the screen. Hit Accept, then Start now.
phone.st.waitingBody: Open NoCap OS on the phone with the screen on — the ask pops up there.
phone.st.deniedBody: Nothing’s shared. Ask again when you’re ready to tap Accept.
phone.st.unsupported: This phone can’t share its screen
phone.st.unsupportedBody: Its Android or the NoCap OS app is too old. Update the app and run it back.
phone.st.goneBody: It got unlinked, or it’s not yours. Pick another one.
phone.controlOff: Control’s off. To tap and type from here, turn on NoCap OS in the phone’s Accessibility settings.
phone.hint: Click to tap, drag to swipe, scroll to scroll, type to type. Right-click or Esc goes back.
